summary: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated, China-based Nasdaq SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting that on September 10, 2026 it issued a $65,000 unsecured, non-interest-bearing promissory note to sponsor Hwei Super Speed Co., Ltd. The funds were deposited into the trust account to extend the initial business combination deadline one month, from September 13, 2026 to October 13, 2026. The note matures on deal closing, is forgiven if no deal closes, and is optionally convertible at $10.00 per unit. Watch redemption levels and further extension requests as the outside date nears.
